summary: Suggested Actions is a SuggestedActionsView that shows on-device action suggestions (events, reminders, locations) under messages in a messaging app. BifrOSt has no messaging app with a message thread view, so there is no counterpart to attach it to.

features.feature: Suggested actions view under a message
features.note: needs a messaging app with message threads; BifrOSt has none

features.feature: Fetch and cache suggestions for a message
features.note: depends on the Apple on-device suggestion model
property of the messaging app's message view

features.feature: Create event from proposed meeting time
features.apple: Essentials example: Calendar event from a proposed time
features.note: find_proposal reads a day, a clock time and a duration phrase from message text into a relative day, start and length; tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-10.rs. Gap: no messaging app passes message text to the finder and no suggestion is shown, so the flow needs a messaging app and the lab machine.

gaps: No messaging app or message view that could host the suggestions view
No on-device suggestion model or API for message content
